title: Escape Rooms Outdoors on the Waters of Key West!
blurb:
Choose your adventure! Castaway, Mermaid, or Conch Quest !! Each charter is four (4) hours, with the escape game being one hour of the adventure (Conch Quest adventure is several hours). 

You will board a large, comfortable deck boat with an experienced captain who will take you to a few beautiful locations for snorkeling, playing the escape adventure, and relaxing and eating/drinking for the remaining time. We provide all safety gear, snorkel gear, ice, bottled water. You provide your own food/drink/towels. Book today!
